sectors.trend: Mixed: coal boom supports BHP, WDS, BOQ; gold exploration active (King River 44g/t, Moonlight diamond); titanium (McLaren) and antimony (Larvotto) grades surge. Oil-driven inflation pressures iron ore demand outlook.
sectors.implications: Coal and gold names benefit from energy shock and safe-haven flows. Iron ore (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) faces headwind if global growth slows. Small-cap explorers (KRG.AX, MLD.AX, MTL.AX, LRV.AX) see speculative interest.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rate hike fears pressure equity valuations; CBA fee controversy (13 years inactive card) damages brand; property credit contraction post-budget threatens NPLs. Star Entertainment (SGH.AX) blames prior management for losses.
sectors.implications: Banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face margin pressure from rate cycle peak and housing stress. SGH.AX remains a turnaround play. Credit growth crash (headline 75) is a leading indicator of NPL build.

sectors.trend: Strong positive. Oil at two-month high on US-Iran conflict; diesel shock 'forever now' (headline 54). Big batteries midnight power raid under regulator scrutiny (headline 24).
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), and coal producers (BOQ.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from elevated oil. Energy transition names face policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: CSL (CSL.AX) signs Trump administration deal to slash medicine prices — significant margin headwind for global pricing power.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX faces compressed ASPs in US market; near-term share price pressure likely. Domestic healthcare (WES.AX, IAG.AX) less affected.

sectors.trend: Negative. Per capita recession risk, housing crash fears, and developer implosion (Bathla, 'Evergrande moment') weigh on consumer confidence and property credit. Renter respite (headline 72) is a minor positive.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face rising rates and credit stress. Consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, LNE.AX) vulnerable to recession narrative. Woolworths (WES.AX) defensive.

sectors.trend: Cautionary. 'Contagion risk' warning from top central banker on AI bubble (headline 56); 'Iran bombs AI bubble' framing (headline 1). Canva (CVA.AX) privacy legal fight adds governance risk.
sectors.implications: Global tech selloff risk spills into ASX tech (CVA.AX, XRO.AX). AI capex cycle may face correction. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Qantas (QAN.AX) ground crew strike vote is a near-term operational risk. Jetstar's early Western Sydney Airport flight is a minor positive.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces disruption risk; strike action could hit Q3 revenue. Aviation sector volatile.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran escalation driving oil spike and global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge equity exposure with energy long (WDS.AX, BOQ.AX) and gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX). Reduce net equity beta.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA 4th rate hike and housing correction (10% fall)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight REITs and property-linked financials. Overweight cash and short-duration bonds. Monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX NPL trends.
Avoid distressed property credit exposure. Monitor Bathla and related construction names. Diversify away from property-adjacent equities.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI bubble 'contagion' and global tech correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce ASX tech (CVA.AX, XRO.AX) exposure. Shift to defensive healthcare and staples.
Avoid QAN.AX near-term. Monitor for operational disruption spillover to tourism and logistics.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: CSL US pricing deal compressing margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reassess CSL.AX DCF under lower ASP assumptions. Consider trimming position pending guidance.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: World debt spiral and per capita recession
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain liquidity. Favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, CBA.AX) over growth. Monitor global credit spreads.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to open lower on oil spike, yield spike, and risk-off flows. 4th RBA hike and housing correction fears cap upside. Energy and gold outperform; REITs, property, and consumer discretionary underperform. Qantas strike adds idiosyncratic risk. Expect 2–4% index decline over 1–3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Per capita recession and world debt spiral (headlines 37, 45) create headwinds. Housing correction of 10% would pressure financials and construction. Coal/energy and gold remain structural positives. AI correction risk adds volatility. RBA likely to hold or cut by H2 2026 if inflation cools, providing eventual relief. Net: choppy, defensive bias.
